subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Where should WhatsApp CTWA attribution identifiers be exposed: model preamble, plugin hook metadata, retained session metadata, or a narrower opt-in surface?
rationale: The field is useful for conversion attribution but is also a tracking identifier, so automation should not choose the prompt, plugin API, and retention boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Expose narrow untrusted CTWA context
options.body: Add a typed WhatsApp CTWA payload with approved fields such as `ctwaClid`, `sourceType`, `sourceId`, `sourceUrl`, and `headline/body` to untrusted channel context and opted-in hooks, without durable retention unless separately approved.

options.title: Plugin-hook only
options.body: Expose CTWA fields only to WhatsApp plugin hooks or a conversion plugin surface, keeping them out of model preambles and session transcripts by default.

options.title: Defer CTWA exposure
options.body: Leave current external-ad title/source/body behavior unchanged until a privacy/security policy for ad attribution identifiers is defined.

recommendation.title: Expose narrow untrusted CTWA context
recommendation.body: Add a typed WhatsApp CTWA payload with approved fields such as `ctwaClid`, `sourceType`, `sourceId`, `sourceUrl`, and `headline/body` to untrusted channel context and opted-in hooks, without durable retention unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest historical signal on the inbound/session normalization path and is a likely routing point for the product/security boundary choice.
